title: Daily briefing: The tell-tale features of a Denisovan
title_zh: 每日简报：丹尼索瓦人的显著特征
abstract: See what gave Denisovans their distinct look. Plus, a vaccine trial for Ebola could kick off this week in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and what makes a great climate graphic.
abstract_zh: 了解了丹尼索瓦人独特外观的特征。此外，埃博拉疫苗试验可能于本周在刚果民主共和国启动，以及构成优秀气候图形的要素。
